description: Use for any crypto market or onchain data request, even if CoinGecko isn't named: coin and token prices, market cap, volume, OHLC and historical charts, supply, categories, top gainers and losers, trending coins, new listings, global market stats; exchanges, tickers, derivatives and funding rates; NFT floor prices; public company and government crypto treasuries; real-world assets (tokenized stocks, commodities, ETFs); crypto news and coin insights; onchain DEX data via GeckoTerminal (pools, trending and new pools, token price by contract address, trades, liquidity events, holders, top traders); wallet balances, holdings or PnL for a wallet address, token transfers and wallet trades. Also use for questions about the CoinGecko API itself: endpoints, plans, API keys, rate limits, errors, WebSocket streams and webhooks.
